A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a novel data‐adaptive procedure for the efficient analysis of randomized trials, which can be applied to both pair‐matched and unmatched studies.
we have proposed a rigorous procedure to adaptively select the adjustment variables for a randomized trial, which maximizes power.
we propose a rigorous data adaptive approach for pre‐specifying the adjustment set for a randomized trial.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the adaptive procedure can be used to maximize the efficiency of the estimator, while maintaining nominal coverage.
the adaptive selection of adjustment variables can be performed rigorously and can substantially increase power.
